UID_SCHEME.function: CPython hash() over the namespace-stripped identifier, as UTF-8 bytes
UID_SCHEME.note: siphash is an interpreter detail, so the interpreter version is part of the build provenance. PASS C re-checks UID -> string injectivity across the whole node universe, so a changed hash surfaces as a mismatch, never as silent drift.

SUBJECTS.reading: distinct_uids == subjects_hashed means the 64-bit UID space separates every subject in Freebase exactly. It is a measurement over all 121.6M of them, not a birthday-bound argument.

ARTIFACT.purpose: PASS B memory-maps this to test, per batch, which object UIDs are not subjects anywhere; only those need their strings emitted.
